Built the transactions page in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with mock data (12 transactions) and styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`, using the Strata design system (`Card`, `DataTable`, `SearchField`, `Select`, `DateRangePicker`, `Badge`, `Amount`, `EmptyState`). It includes:

- A table with date, description, category, status (colored badge) and amount (tinted +/- currency) columns, sortable.
- A toolbar above the table with a search field (filters by description), a category `Select`, and a `DateRangePicker` for date range filtering, all combined client-side.
- An "Export CSV" button in the card header that downloads the currently filtered rows as a CSV via a Blob URL, disabled when there's nothing to export.
- An empty state (icon + message + "Clear filters" action) shown inside the table when no transaction matches the active filters.

I couldn't run the app per your instructions, so this hasn't been visually verified in a browser — worth a quick check once you can run it.
